facts.text: Chomp Chomp Food Centre opened in 1972.
Chomp Chomp's name is an English adaptation of the older Teochew Tiong Tiong.
Tiong Tiong means loyalty and righteousness in Teochew.
East Coast Lagoon Food Village was built on reclaimed land.
East Coast Lagoon Food Village opened as a hawker centre in 1978.
Geylang Serai Market was opened in 1964 by then Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew.
Geylang Serai Market was rebuilt in 2009.
Geylang Serai Market's rebuilt architecture draws on Malay cultural heritage.
Maxwell Food Centre was a site of a post-war low-cost meals programme.
Newton Food Centre was the first Singapore hawker centre built with a garden setting.
Old Airport Road Food Centre was completed in 1973.
People's Park Food Centre began as a hawker shelter in 1923.
By 1940 the People's Park market was Singapore's largest fresh-produce market.
Tekka Market was built in 1915.
Tekka Market was previously called Kandang Kerbau Market.
Kandang Kerbau means buffalo enclosure in Malay.
Tiong Bahru Market opened in 1951 under the name Seng Poh Road Market.
The old Tiong Bahru Market was used for public meetings and political rallies.
Singapore's national flower is Vanda Miss Joaquim.
Vanda Miss Joaquim was announced as national flower on 15 April 1981.
Vanda Miss Joaquim is a cross between Vanda hookeriana and Vanda teres.
Vanda Miss Joaquim is named after Agnes Joaquim.
Agnes Joaquim bred the national-flower orchid in 1893.
Vanda Miss Joaquim was recorded as Singapore's first orchid hybrid.
Vanda Miss Joaquim was recorded as the world's first Vanda hybrid.
Agnes Joaquim was a second-generation Singapore-born Armenian.
Agnes Joaquim was born on 7 April 1854.
Agnes Joaquim won more than 70 annual flower-show awards.
Over 40 flower types were considered when choosing the national flower.
